sheetReferenceSemantics.status: source audit and cross-sheet formula-origin move repair implemented; sheet-relative persistence remains open
sheetReferenceSemantics.storage: Calc ScSingleRefData stores sheet relativity independently of row/column and 3D display. SetAddress subtracts the formula sheet index only for a relative sheet; toAbs adds the evaluation sheet index. Each range endpoint has its own flags.
sheetReferenceSemantics.odf: Calc preserves the leading sheet $ through TAB_ABS, SetTabRel and MakeOneRefStrImpl, including quoted names. Its address parser forces external sheets absolute. An omitted second-endpoint sheet inherits an absolute first-sheet flag; an explicitly named second endpoint has its own flag. Gnumeric-compatible marker stripping is a candidate limitation, not ODF semantics.
sheetReferenceSemantics.relocation: AdjustReferenceOnMovedOrigin resolves at the old position and rebinds at the new one. AdjustReferenceOnMove additionally tracks references into the moved cell range. AdjustReferenceOnMovedTab remaps actual tabs before rebinding offsets. These are distinct operations; moving a sheet must not retarget relative references by keeping an old numeric offset.
sheetReferenceSemantics.copyCaveat: Ordinary token offsets and AdjustReferenceOnCopy support relative translation, but the formula-cell clone path may request AdjustCrossSheetRefs. AdjustRelativeTabRefs then preserves nonzero cross-sheet targets while leaving same-sheet offset zero unchanged. Do not infer every UI copy operation from the token flags alone. The concrete caller ScDocument::OverwriteContent requests AdjustCrossSheetRefs; CopyTab instead performs a separate updateReferencesAfterTabInsertion pass. The clone flag declaration explicitly distinguishes these modes. That post-insertion pass explicitly calls AdjustRelativeTabRefs with TargetTabState::Inserted after updating absolute tab references. Whole-sheet copy therefore also preserves cross-sheet targets with insertion adjustment; it cannot use plain origin-copy offset translation.
sheetReferenceSemantics.candidate: Shared formula fields retain standard of:= expressions when named relative sheets are present. AST endpoints retain sheetRelative and sheetOffset, with workbook order captured at the parse origin. Recalculation resolves relative named expressions at the caller sheet. Copy translation follows tab offset; move translation retains physical targets. ODF markers persist directly. XML/XLSX preserve original OpenFormula and named-expression anchor in the existing ssconvert namespace beside fixed-target formulas. Readers ignoring annotations lose relative-sheet copy semantics. BIFF7/8 exports fixed targets at the formula or name declaration anchor with an explicit loss warning; unsupported textual grammars refuse silent loss. CLI --set and SDK text updates accept OpenFormula.

biffDataTables.finding: DATATABLE/DATATABLE2 follow the table anchor FORMULA, whose cells use tTbl pointers. Row and column modes take formulas/values from the table borders; two-input mode evaluates the top-left border formula. Gnumeric maps this to TABLE(rowInput,columnInput), leaving the unused argument empty. LibreOffice TableOp agrees for BIFF5/8; its inspected dispatch does not establish BIFF2/3/4 support. Those original layouts follow the published specification, including the 12-byte BIFF2 single-input record and separate 16-byte DATATABLE2.

Input substitution and restoration use the existing evaluator. Qualified input references follow TABLE own-sheet coordinate semantics without external lookup.

biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.recordLayout: Excel File Format 1.42 section 5.64: BIFF8 opcode 0x015f contains row-label and column-label counted range lists, in that order. Each range is eight bytes. Its tNlr section 3.10.4 remains an unimplemented documentation placeholder, so it cannot establish operand semantics.
biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.import: ReadLabelranges converts declared labels into label/data pairs. Row data extends right to the Calc document column limit, or left when the label reaches that limit; column data analogously extends down or up. The importer uses document limits, not the BIFF record field limit. This profile distinction still needs native qualification.
biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.evaluation: GetRefColRowNames first consults ordered label/data pairs. Automatic ranges use label text/empty cells, formula position and the next declared data range to choose their boundaries. Binary-operator neighbors and beginning/end positions select a scalar; label/intersection neighbors preserve ranges. A missing scalar intersection returns NoRef. Single-cell ranges remain position independent. Axis-relative flags survive the resulting reference.
biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.export: XclExpLabelranges stores only label ranges, not paired data endpoints. It narrows row labels to the first column for Excel97/2000/XP, then writes the two range lists. This is an observable normalization, not lossless pair preservation.
biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.currentCode: Ordered label metadata and lookup settings are implemented. Live BIFF8 row/column subtypes 02/03/06/07 retain their anchor, reference class, quoting and addressing flags, with Calc-derived scalar/contiguous-region evaluation. Radical 0A and multiple-cell radical 0B preserve the authoritative following Area/AreaErr, its independent endpoint flags and token class; 0B also preserves its ordered RgbExtra member list and shared relativity. Structural edits and dependencies include every label member and explicit range. Native ODF/legacy OpenOffice same-sheet label metadata import and ODF export retain ordered explicit data pairs and lookup settings. Inferred multiple-cell forms, live formula transports, cross-sheet metadata and native qualification remain open.
biffLiveLabelRangeAudit.nextAction: Resolve inferred multi-cell ColS/ColSV and applicable older row forms from primary sources; RadicalS ordered RgbExtra is implemented. NameParsedFormula forbids direct ELF tokens, so NAME transport needs a different loss-characterized representation. Qualify native behavior and XML/XLSX/ODF identity transport; no family is closed.

flagAndContextAudit.layout: ColElfU bits 0..13 are a column field constrained to 0..255; bit 14 preserves quoted label occurrences; bit 15 selects relative versus absolute coordinates for both row and column. RgceElfLoc stores the label address. The importer must not discard flags or truncate invalid column-field bits.
flagAndContextAudit.calcDifference: excform8.cxx ignores the high bits and infers one relative axis from the subtype. xeformula.cxx always emits relative NLR for cell/matrix/chart base positions and converts NAME/shared contexts to ordinary references. This normalization is not lossless BIFF label transport. The ssconvert model preserves the published on-file flag semantics instead.
